title: The second of January, 2025
logline: The alley the second morning of the year: a bottle on the tavern's step, the pup at the door waiting, the window lit. The same page as 2022, three years on; the dog slower to stand. The page keeps the composition and changes the dog.

panels.composition: A gravel alley in gray morning light with an empty bottle on a tavern's back step and an old three-legged dog standing at a lit garage door waiting, its back legs stiff.
